text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'm going to rest for a bit.
Good night...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? Is this the Student Council Room?
When did I even get here...?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Where's the checklist...
Ah, just as I thought, here it is.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(That's Air Groove-san!
Whoa, she's coming this way! I-I'm so nervous!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Time to say hello... wait, huh, no sound's coming out!
Come to think of it, my vision is weird, and I can't move!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Eeeek! S-Somebody just lifted me up?!
W-What is going on here?!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's see... The checklist is...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Wait, you're way too close! If you stare at me from this close... hawaa~!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Ahya?! A-Ahaha...! The pen nib... tickles!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(H-Huh? Am I... did I turn into
paperwork...!?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(...Hah! I can't move again!?
What did I turn into this time—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...What a nice scent.
I really do love these tea leaves.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(D-D-D-Dober-san! So gorgeous~~!!
Huh?! This warm sensation is—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Me, in a teacup?!
Ah, ah, at this rate—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Even if it's Dober-san, who I admire so much, th-that's... a big NOOOOOOO!!!!)
(RUUUUMBLE――!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(That sound... footsteps galloping across the turf!?
!! That person is—!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Ramonu-san...! What have I become next, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Th-This angle is............ TURF!!!!
...I've turned into the turf~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...Still, if Ramonu-san will run past me, then I...!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“......*Gasp*! A-A dream!?
Y-Yeah, that makes sense......”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with everyone I admire...
What a thrilling, exciting, and fun dream that was♪

Perhaps because of having a good dream,
Rhein Kraft was able to get back into top shape.
